edits.old: Then the case stays "NEW" with no queue change
edits.new:
Then the case stays "NEW" with no queue change

  Scenario: AC19 A provided operation answers 401, 403 or 404 when the request is refused (NEWAC-RWB-P3-E1020-APP-AC16)
    Given a request to a provided operation without valid credentials, without the right role, or for a resource that does not exist
    When the request is sent
    Then the response status is 401, 403 or 404 as the error is defined in the API Specification

  Scenario: AC20 A failed or timed-out activity is retried under its activity policy (NEWAC-RWB-P3-E1020-APP-AC17)
    Given an activity of the case workflow fails or does not finish within its timeout
    When the activity is retried
    Then the retry count and timeout follow the activity policy, which is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P3-E1020-APP-AC17)
    Then a non-retryable failure such as NoPackageInForce is not retried

  Scenario: AC21 A consumed call that fails or does not answer leaves the case unchanged (NEWAC-RWB-P3-E1020-APP-AC18)
    Given the rwb-decision contract mock fails or does not answer the call for case RW-2026-000201
    When the morning allocation run starts
    Then the case stays "NEW" with no queue and no owner
    Then no decision record is written for the case

  Scenario: AC22 A status change the model does not allow is refused (NEWAC-RWB-P3-E1020-APP-AC19)
    Given case RW-2026-000201 has status "NEW"
    When a status change is requested that the status model does not allow
    Then the change is refused and the case keeps its status "NEW"
